contract_scope: static trace/accounting schema and validation mapping only; no TOKEN-03/TOKEN-04 runtime traces captured
tokenizer_accounting_version_required: must be recorded per trace; TOKEN-01 setup value is xiigen-heuristic-word-punctuation/v1/heuristic-estimate until TOKEN-03/TOKEN-04 select an approved exact counter

raw_redacted_trace_contract.raw_private_trace_ref: required reference to approved private raw input/output/debug trace storage; shared artifact must not copy private raw content
raw_redacted_trace_contract.redacted_trace_ref: required reference to redacted shared trace suitable for review
raw_redacted_trace_contract.input_text_ref_or_hash: required private ref or sha256 hash of input text
raw_redacted_trace_contract.output_text_ref_or_hash: required private ref or sha256 hash of output text
raw_redacted_trace_contract.redaction_policy: required and must match across baseline/adaptive records

token_accounting_fields.counted_spans: array naming prompt, debug, tool, response, and any excluded spans
token_accounting_fields.tokenizer_accounting_version: exact tokenizer/accounting version and estimate/exact mode

pairing_integrity_checks.rule: baseline and adaptive records must share the exact TOKEN-01 pair_id
host and host runtime/live_scope must match
scenario_id, prompt_hash/ref, method, debug setting and invocation options must match
evidence_class/live_scope must match; dashboard/API/helper/handler-only cannot be paired as live host savings evidence
target_locator_mode and locator ref must match except explicit baseline common/no-adaptive versus adaptive user-local target variable
tokenizer_accounting_version, token_counter_name/version, counted_spans and estimate/exact mode must match
raw/private and redacted refs must use the same redaction policy
QUALITY-03 same-pair non-regression must PASS before any token savings claim
claim_allowed remains false in TOKEN-02 and any incomplete trace/accounting row
